 Commonwealth Child Migration Scheme
 Provide a letter from the Child Migrants Trust stating that you came to Australia without your parents: between 22 September 1947 and 31 December 1967 and it was under the Commonwealth Child Migration Scheme.
 Evidence to meet the special residence requirement
-Check your eligibility for the special residence requirement. Refer to the tables below for the evidence you should give us: Seeking to engage in activities of benefit to Australia Activity Organisation Evidence If you are seeking to participate as an athlete in an Australian team Australian Olympic and Paralympics Committees Commonwealth Games Australia Tennis Australia (Davis Cup or Billie Jean Cup) Cricket Australia (men’s or women’s international cricket match) A letter from the head, or senior position holder of the relevant organisation. This needs to state that you have a reasonable prospect of being engaged in the activity, and A letter from the relevant organisation confirming: the qualifying events you are seeking selection for dates of the qualifying events which of the qualifying events you must compete in which of the qualifying events you must be an Australian citizen for the last date you can become an Australian citizen and still be eligible for selection. If you are seeking employment in a position that needs a Negative Vetting 2 or higher security clearance A Commonwealth: department executive agency statutory agency a letter from the head, or senior position holder of the agency. This needs to state that you have a reasonable prospect of them employing you in a position evidence from the Commonwealth department or agency that the employment you are seeking needs a Negative Vetting 2 or higher security clearance a letter from the Commonwealth department or agency that includes: why your engagement in that activity would benefit Australia why you need to be an Australian citizen to engage in that activity and why there is insufficient time for you to meet the general residence requirement. Engaged in particular kinds of work requiring regular travel outside Australia Activity Kinds of work Evidence If you are engaged in particular kinds of work at the time of application and for a total of at least 2 years in the past 4 years; and you were required to regularly travel outside Australia for that work during the four year period Work that is done: on duty by a crew member of a ship or aircraft; or on duty on a resources installation or a sea installation, or as an employee of an S&P/ASX All Australian 200 listed company in one of the following positions: a chief executive officer, or an executive manager, or research and development of benefit to Australia done as a scientist or an academic awarded a Doctor of Philosophy in their field of specialty, and is employed by an Australian university; or as a scientist employed by: the Commonwealth Scientific and Industrial Research Organisation (CSIRO); or a medical research institute that is a member of the Association of Australian Medical Research Institutes (AAMRI); or as a medical specialist internationally renowned in their field, who: is a fellow of an organisation listed in column 1 of an item in the table in clause 1 in Schedule 1 to the Health Insurance Regulations 2018, and holds a qualification relevant to the organisation in association with a person’s Distinguished Talent visa (DTV) or Global Talent visa (GTV). This needs to have been processed under the Distinguished Talent pathway. The work needs to be in the same field we granted the visa for and in one of the following areas: academia and research the arts a profession a sport. work as a minister of religion in a senior leadership position role in a religious organisation. Work includes activities done while performing: senior religious leadership and pastoral duties; or executive governance or administrative functions of the religious organisation; or ceremonial, representative or community engagement duties completed while a minister of religion in a senior leadership position. Evidence of kind of work and regular travel outside Australia because of employment Documents from your employer showing that when you applied and for a period of 2 years in the past 4 years, you worked in one of the specified kinds of work listed below. This must show that the work needed regular travel outside Australia. Examples include: letter from employer employment contracts pay slips logbooks overseas meeting and conference agendas with dates of the meetings invitations to present at conferences overseas shift-work schedules with dates worked. The documents must also show that the periods spent outside Australia during that two-year period were for that work. Chief executive officer or executive manager of an S&P/ASX All Australian 200 listed company Along with evidence of the kind of work and regular travel outside Australia because of employment, also give us: evidence that states that you work for a S&P/ASX All Australian 200 listed company. This needs to be as a chief executive officer or executive manager, and for executive managers, evidence that confirms you report directly to the most senior person in the company. Scientist or academic completing research and development of benefit to Australia, awarded a Doctor of Philosophy in their field of speciality and employed by an Australian university Along with evidence of the kind of work and regular travel outside Australia because of employment, also give us evidence that: you hold a Doctor of Philosophy in the field of speciality of your work with an Australian university, and the research and development you are completing with an Australian university is of benefit to Australia. This may include: published articles/work in peer reviewed journals or books evidence you get funding from an Australian body for this research. if you are a scientist, evidence from the Australian university employing you to confirm your employment as a scientist. You must be qualified in one of the following branches of science: natural social formal. if you are an academic, evidence from the Australian university employing you to confirm your employment as an academic and the discipline in which you are qualified. Scientist (CSIRO) or medical research institute member of AAMRI Along with evidence of the kind of work and regular travel outside Australia because of employment, also give us: evidence from the CSIRO or AAMRI that they consider you a scientist qualified in one of the following branches of science: natural social formal. Medical specialist internationally renowned in their field, who: is a fellow of an organisation listed in column 1 of an item in the table in clause 1 in Schedule 1 to the Health Insurance Regulations 2018 and holds a qualification relevant to the organisation. Along with evidence of the kind of work and regular travel outside Australia because of employment types above, also give us: evidence that you hold a qualification relevant to the organisation you work for, and evidence of international recognition of exceptional and outstanding achievement in your field of work as a medical specialist. This may include but is not limited to: written work for internationally renowned journals papers presented at international conferences in your field of expertise work as an international consultant with universities or hospitals.
